technical_and_design_decisions: U1 will be implemented as a new shell command using the existing Spring Cloud Data Flow (s-c-d) DSL parser, exposing runtime metadata (host, port, module URI, version) sourced from the deployed runtime (e.g., Local, Cloud Foundry, Kubernetes, YARN).

U2 will be implemented as a new SPI deployer implementation targeting Hadoop YARN, using Spring YARN / hadoop-client APIs and the existing AppDeployer SPI to submit stream/task apps as YARN applications.

U3 will reuse the Spring XD 'file' source module logic and re-implement it against the Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) module SPI, registering it as a Spring Boot-based source module with a Maven coordinate under org.springframework.cloud.stream.module.

U4 will refactor the Gradle build into multiple sub-modules so each SPI deployer (Local, Cloud Foundry, Kubernetes, YARN, Mesos) can be built and released independently, decoupling the 'admin' module from the full deployer matrix.

U5 will eliminate the XDRuntimeException class by replacing its usages with more specific Spring/RuntimeException subclasses (DataFlowException, IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException) and introducing consistent error propagation across the codebase.

U6 will upgrade the GemFire sink module to the latest release (Pivotal GemFire / Apache Geode 9.x) by bumping dependencies, migrating deprecated APIs, and verifying against GemFire 9.x client/server topology.

U7 will implement a new SFTP source module using Spring Integration's SFTP support (SftpInboundFileSynchronizer/SftpRemoteFileTemplate), packaging it as a Spring Boot executable module and publishing it to maven repo.

U8 will close remaining CI gaps by adding/fixing Concourse pipelines for Data Flow, Skipper, Application, and the deployer modules, ensuring every commit runs the appropriate test matrix (unit, integration, end-to-end).
All work targets Java 17 baseline per Spring Framework 6 / Spring Boot 3 requirements.
Testing will use the existing spring-cloud-dataflow-acceptance-tests suite where applicable, plus module-level unit and integration tests with Testcontainers.
assumptions: The estimator is a single senior developer fluent in the Spring ecosystem (Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Integration, Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Cloud Data Flow).

Specifications placeholders (e.g. {{host}}, {{port}}, {{admin}}, {{XDRuntimeException}}) are interpreted based on context from the surrounding Spring Cloud Data Flow / Spring XD ecosystem as indicated in the user stories.
The build system is Gradle (consistent with Spring Cloud Data Flow), and existing module conventions apply.
No infrastructure provisioning (Hadoop/YARN/GemFire cluster bring-up for production) is included; only the software code and configuration needed to deploy onto those platforms.
Local development environment, CI runners, and maven repo accounts already exist.
Upgrading transitive dependencies (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring Cloud) is not required by these user stories and is therefore out of scope.
Effort estimates cover development, unit/integration test authoring, and local validation only; end-user documentation updates are limited to module/README additions.

activities.activity_description: Review the eight user stories, clarify dependencies between them (e.g., YARN deployer U2 vs. admin/build refactor U4), produce a short design note covering shell command surface, deployer SPI additions, module SPI mapping, build layout, and CI pipeline topology.

Add a new shell command (e.g., 'runtime info') that lists host, port, app/server version, and module metadata. Implement the metadata provider, the command handler, help text, and tests for Local runtime; stub for other runtimes.

Implement a YARN-targeted AppDeployer (and ClusterService) under the SPI: package stream/task modules as YARN applications, implement submit/list/status/log/destroy using Spring YARN/hadoop-client, add configuration properties, and provide integration tests against an embedded mini-YARN cluster.

activities.activity_name: U3: Port 'file' source module from XD
activities.activity_description: Migrate the Spring XD file source to the s-c-s module SPI: re-implement using Spring Integration file inbound adapter, expose configuration properties, package as a Spring Boot module, register metadata, and add unit/integration tests plus docs.

activities.activity_name: U4: Refactor build to bundle SPI deployers individually
activities.activity_description: Split the monolithic admin/deployer build into per-deployer Gradle sub-projects (Local, CF, K8s, YARN, Mesos), introduce a deployer-spi module, ensure the admin module depends only on what it needs, verify each sub-module can be built and released in isolation, update CI to matrix-build them.

activities.activity_name: U5: Remove XDRuntimeException from XD legacy code
activities.activity_description: Inventory all uses of XDRuntimeException, replace with appropriate Spring/standard exceptions (DataFlowException, IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException, RuntimeException subtypes), update tests, and remove the deprecated class.

activities.activity_name: U6: Upgrade GemFire sink module to latest release
activities.activity_description: Bump GemFire/Geode client dependency to the latest 9.x release, migrate any deprecated APIs, adjust region/lucene/serializer configuration as needed, and add/extend integration tests to validate write-through to a GemFire region.

Build a new SFTP source module using Spring Integration's SFTP session factory and inbound channel adapter, expose remote directory/filename/filter/credentials properties, package as a Spring Boot module, publish to maven repo, and add acceptance-style tests against a local SFTP server (Apache MINA SSHD embedded).

activities.activity_name: U8: Resolve CI pipeline gaps for Data Flow family
activities.activity_description: Audit Concourse pipelines for Data Flow, Skipper, Stream Apps, and per-deployer modules; add/fix missing jobs (unit, integration, end-to-end, smoke), wire dependency triggers so every commit triggers the right matrix; document pipeline ownership.

Run and stabilize the spring-cloud-dataflow-acceptance-tests suite against the Local deployer with the new/updated modules (file, SFTP, GemFire), validate the new shell command (U1) end-to-end, and add smoke coverage for the YARN deployer (U2).

Update reference docs and module READMEs: new shell command (U1), YARN deployer usage (U2), file source migration note (U3), build/release notes for split deployers (U4), GemFire upgrade notes (U6), SFTP module reference (U7), and CI pipeline overview (U8).

activities.activity_name: Code review, hardening, and bug fix buffer
activities.activity_description: Address review feedback, fix defects found during integration testing, stabilize flaky tests, and perform final polishing across all changes.
